thread:
nora: did a quick bring-up for monsoon-11b int6 vs int8. small smoke results + recommended minimal canary. want GTN/product tolerances before we schedule.

kevin: paste top-line pls (latency, cost, quality deltas).

nora: short table (mixed slices, ~3k samples each):\n```\nModel                | p50 | p90 | toks/s | cost/tok | QA-F1 | rouge delta\nmonsoon-11b-int8     | 110ms| 380ms| 90     | $0.0026  | 0.795 | baseline\nmonsoon-11b-int6     | 75ms | 170ms| 135    | $0.0015  | 0.773 | -0.022\n```\n
eval-bot: automated checks: retrieval MRR -0.8%, summarization rouge -0.022, hallucination +0.15pp. latency p90 improved ~55%.

sara: unit econ numbers?

nora: int6 ~=43% cheaper per-token. For our typical chat (130 gen toks) that's ~ $0.0112 saved per response. At 750k/day that's ~$8.4k/day.

kevin: product note : -0.022 rouge might be visible on long-form. recommend hybrid route: chat -> int6, long/high-precision -> int8.

nora: propose canary: 10% int6 / 90% int8 for 48h, monitor MRR, rouge, hallucination, latency p90, error-rate. Calibration batch: 50k prod prompts daily. Ramp to 50/50 if deltas within thresholds (MRR drop <=1%, rouge <=0.03). Final if unit-cost reduction >30% and no large slice regressions, default non-critical -> int6.

deploy-bot: infra check  both variants supported on Dedicated; int6 requires new kernel flag but deployable.

sara: add a 24h rollback window after each ramp and per-product alerting.

kevin: agreed. @nora pls drop a one-pager + eval link by EOD so GTN can sign off. :thumbsup:

nora: will do.
